Page sizes are 26/8 items for the ODE pair and 17/9 for the gauge-integral pair. No split, forward reference, external fallback, or cross-batch dependency is proposed. All 64 external dependencies are published, provenance-eligible, and homed below this batch’s order. The contracts cover all 52 proof-bearing items.

Principal correction: Peano existence now uses Euler polygonal approximations plus vector-valued Arzelà–Ascoli. The Picard-iterate compactness route was rejected because Lebl’s current errata identifies it as invalid. The detailed Alpha recommendations and applyable design amendments are recorded in the notes. Sources were harvested from [Teschl](https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~gerald/ftp/book-ode/ode.pdf), [Lebl](https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/sec_picard.html), [Fonda](https://dmi.units.it/~fonda/p2017_book_KH.pdf), and [Bruckner–Bruckner–Thomson](https://classicalrealanalysis.info/documents/BBT-AlllChapters-Landscape.pdf).
